protocol_variants.title: Fresh trial with 1 mL HCl
protocol_variants.sample_policy: Independent protocol; do not concatenate with other variants. Within this protocol preserve each named sample; new aliquots/trials need separate state tracks and reference images.

procedure_steps.instruction: Take a fresh 50 mL aliquot of 0.1 M sodium thiosulphate in a 100 mL beaker; keep the temperature constant.
procedure_steps.quantity_constraint: Use only the stated dose for this sample. Unknown doses remain unset; do not substitute equal additions or convert drops to mL.

procedure_steps.instruction: Add 1 mL 1 M HCl, swirl and start timing halfway through this transfer.
procedure_steps.observation: Sulphur formation gradually obscures the cross below the beaker.
procedure_steps.quantity_constraint: Use only the stated dose for this sample. Unknown doses remain unset; do not substitute equal additions or convert drops to mL.

procedure_steps.instruction: Stop timing when the cross disappears and record the measured elapsed time.
procedure_steps.observation: Compare this independent trial with the other prescribed acid volumes; do not invent a time.
procedure_steps.quantity_constraint: Use only the stated dose for this sample. Unknown doses remain unset; do not substitute equal additions or convert drops to mL.
